description: Single source of truth for TokenPort upstream-sync conflict resolution. Consumed by token-platform/prompts/codex-upstream-sync-autonomy.md (end-to-end autonomy), token-platform/scripts/resolve_tokenport_i18n_conflicts.ps1 (i18n subset only), and any agent following scripts/sync/upstream-conflict-agent-prompt.md. Update this file (not the scripts) when the fork conflict surface changes.

gitConfig.note: Documentation of the repo-local settings the merge requires. The autonomy prompt, token-platform/scripts/sync_upstream_and_deploy.ps1, and .github/workflows/tokenport-upstream-sync.yml apply them idempotently. Keep all consumers in agreement.

resolutionRules.reason: TokenPort rebrands these documents entirely; upstream edits to them are irrelevant to the fork. Normally enforced by .gitattributes merge=ours so they never conflict; if one still conflicts, take the fork side.

Append-heavy files where the fork adds keys or providers next to upstream lines. Resolution: take the full upstream side, then re-apply the fork's delta from the merge base as a zero-context patch (git apply --unidiff-zero). If the patch does not apply, both sides changed the same lines - escalate instead of guessing.
resolutionRules.postChecks: wire_gen.go and wire.go must still compile; the dockerized backend test gate (go test -tags=unit ./...) verifies this after resolution.

resolutionRules.reason: Generated lockfiles: take the upstream side, then regenerate so any fork-side manifest change is reflected deterministically.

frontend/public/skill-market/ is a generated mirror of ../state-of-art-skills. Never hand-merge its JSON, zip, or markdown files. Rebuild the source registry, validate checksums, then run scripts/sync-skill-market.ps1 and stage the generated paths. If the source repo itself is dirty or cannot produce a compatible archive, escalate to semantic resolution.
commands: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sync-skill-market.ps1 -SkillRepoPath <workspace>/state-of-art-skills (run in the fork root)

resolutionRules.reason: Every other conflict is semantic (upstream and fork changed the same logic). The autonomy prompt continues with a full three-way semantic merge; the CI-generated conflict brief may stop and report. Never resolve semantic conflicts by whole-file ours/theirs, deleting tests, or editing this policy to bypass the merge.

validationGates.overlay: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-tokenport-overlay.ps1 (run from the fork root)
validationGates.frontend: corepack pnpm@9.15.9 install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm@9.15.9 lint:check && corepack pnpm@9.15.9 typecheck && corepack pnpm@9.15.9 test:run && corepack pnpm@9.15.9 build (run in frontend/). CI pins the pnpm 9 major; deploy/Dockerfile pins 9.15.9, which is the reproducible local version.
validationGates.backend: docker run --rm -v <fork>/backend:/src -w /src golang:1.26.5-alpine go test -tags=unit ./... (token-platform/scripts/check_tokenport_ci_parity.ps1 adds golangci-lint and pnpm-audit parity; GitHub CI additionally runs integration-tagged tests, which only run there)

invariants: Never force-push, rebase, or rewrite history on any branch.
Never commit directly to the product branch; all merges land on a sync/upstream-* branch and reach tokenport/main by fast-forward only.
Never delete either side functionality to make a conflict disappear.
Never edit this policy file, .gitattributes, or CI workflows as a way to bypass a conflict.

Pushing tokenport/main and the sync branch is allowed only by the end-to-end autonomy prompt, and only after local validation and exact-SHA GitHub CI/Security Scan gates pass. Standalone conflict-resolution agents must not push.
Never modify persistent git proxy, npm registry, or Windows proxy configuration during synchronization.

maintenance.markers: requiredMarkers entries are brand/feature strings that must survive resolution. Update them here when TokenPort copy or the billing feature changes; scripts read them from this file.
maintenance.extending: To auto-resolve a new recurring conflict, add its file to replay-fork-delta (append-type), theirs-then-regenerate (generated), or regenerate-from-source (mirror of state-of-art-skills) after two consecutive manual resolutions prove the pattern is stable.

i18n.contract: Run only when every remaining unmerged file is in scope and at least one scope file is unmerged. The script exits 0 after resolving those files; it throws for Unsupported merge conflicts. Any other outcome means skip it and continue semantic resolution.
i18n.verifyBeforeUse: Test-Path the script, then read it in full before the first invocation. Verify its actual contract instead of trusting its filename.

legacyGenericResolver.rule: Never call it and never fabricate its output. If it appears later, read it in full and verify its contract before use.
